models.name: AutoSOTA
models._note: End-to-end automated research system (Yu Li, Chenyang Shao et al, arxiv 2604.05550v1). 8 specialized agents: AgentResource, AgentObjective, AgentInit, AgentMonitor, AgentFix, AgentIdeator, AgentScheduler, AgentSupervisor. Filters 105 papers from 8 top-tier AI conferences (NeurIPS / ICLR / ICML / CVPR / ICCV / ACL / NAACL / AAAI) via 4-stage filtering (methodological + artifact-availability + readiness + execution-cost <=4 GPU-hours), then automated replication + AutoSoTA Improvement search. Average 5 hours per paper. Max improvement 63.64% (ID 70 'Certified Unlearning'). 6 case-study domains: LLM, NLP, Biology, CV, Time Series, Optimization.

models.name: Empirical Research Assistance (ERA)
models._note: Nature 10658-6 (Aygün, Belyaeva, Comanici et al, accepted May 13 2026). LLM + Tree Search system that creates expert-level scientific software to maximize a quality metric. Caltech + MIT + Harvard + McGill + Google DeepMind + Google Research.

models.name: FutureHouse Multi-Agent Discovery System
models._note: Nature 10652-y (Ghareeb, Chang, Mitchener et al, accepted May 12 2026). Multi-agent system for automating scientific discovery. Distinct from prior FutureHouse Falcon/Owl/PaperQA2/Phoenix models — this is a meta-orchestration layer that uses multiple FutureHouse agents.

scores._section: === Microsoft MDASH — internal Windows kernel testing (May 12 2026 blog) ===
scores._note: All 21 ground-truth vulnerabilities correctly identified with zero false positives.
96% recall on 28 MSRC cases spanning 5 years (clfs.sys component).
100% recall on 7 MSRC cases spanning 5 years (tcpip.sys component).
16 NEW vulnerabilities discovered in Windows networking stack including 4 Critical remote code execution flaws. Orchestrates 100+ specialized AI agents.
Automated evaluations across 15 complex expert-curated open scientific goals. Multi-agent system built on Gemini with self-play debate + tournament-based evolution + asynchronous task execution.

End-to-end biomedicine validation in 3 distinct domains: (1) drug repurposing for AML (acute myeloid leukemia) — selective cytotoxicity at clinically-relevant concentrations validated in vitro; (2) novel epigenetic target discovery for liver fibrosis — anti-fibrotic + hepatocyte-regeneration activity in human hepatic organoids; (3) antimicrobial resistance — cf-PICIs phage-tail mechanism hypothesis matched independent researchers' unpublished findings.
